description: Find personalized Muhurta (shubh muhurat) windows, the best date and time to start a named Vedara activity, over a maximum 32-day inclusive range. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Free with a connected Vedara account that has a completed birth profile. An empty new-start result may include empty_state with its classical delay explanation and next_good (local date, start/end times and score), searched up to 14 days ahead within the account's Timing horizon, or a fallback suggestion. Operates only within the connected user's bounded private Vedara account. Uses saved or explicitly supplied coordinates and Vedara calculations, without public geocoding, web search, external recipients, or public publishing. Authentication, audit events, and rate limits are private account operations.
name: find_auspicious_time
title: Find an auspicious time
